title: MomoPulse
shortDescription: The launchpad terminal for Cookie Chain — sees the bonding-curve positions no wallet can.
description: MomoSwap Launchpad buys mint curve shares tracked in per-pool UserPosition PDAs — invisible to every wallet, explorer and portfolio tracker. MomoPulse derives every PDA, decodes it with genesis-verified layouts, values it with the program-exact quoteSell math, and turns it into a trading terminal: live pool feed, bonding-curve canvas with your entry pins, true-positions drawer with one-flow claim sweeping, a gasless relayer (claims at 0 COOK) and a starter drip for brand-new wallets. Includes the safety layer judges asked for: mint-authority checks, Token-2022 transfer-hook detection, impostor-symbol flags and genesis-hash wrong-network interception.
